summary: Maison Solutions Inc. filed an 8-K to announce it received Nasdaq notice confirming regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company had been non-compliant since July 10, 2025, received a 180-day cure period extended to July 6, 2026, and resolved the deficiency on May 11, 2026. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or corporate action is involved. This is a routine compliance update with no special-situation characteristics; the filing merely reports continued listing eligibility.
